dog.description_text:
Meet Iggy Pup: From Left Behind to Loved

At just nine weeks old, Iggy’s little life got off to a heartbreaking start. After his siblings were sold, he was left outside in New Jersey simply because no one wanted him. When he was found, he was in rough shape, facing a world that hadn’t been very kind to him yet.

But Iggy’s story didn’t end there.

With a little love, proper treatment, and someone finally in his corner, this tiny underdog began his comeback. Today, he’s happy, healthy, thriving, and making up for every bit of love he missed out on. And if you ask Iggy, the best part of his new life is getting to share it with everyone he meets.

This little guy is equal parts playful puppy and professional snuggle buddy. He loves romping around with his dog and cat friends, covering his favorite people in kisses, and curling up close when it’s time to recharge. He’s met children and babies and done wonderfully with both, and even vet visits are a happy occasion. During his vaccinations, he was still wagging his little tail! Iggy has already overcome more in his first nine weeks than any puppy should have to. Now, he’s ready for the part every puppy deserves: a person of his very own. Someone to bond with, grow up alongside, and shower with all the love packed into his tiny little body.

He may have started life unwanted, but Iggy is proof that a rough beginning doesn’t have to define your story. His next chapter is waiting, and we have a feeling it’s going to be his best one yet.

Could you be Iggy’s person?
dog.name: Iggy
